description: Land Title Settlement Department - Willorawatta, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520264 (23/0108)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 150 and No. 31) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, identity card numbers, and title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
